value.description: Bsure shows every identity in your Microsoft 365 and Entra ID tenant, what it can reach, and who is answerable for it. Read-only, in your own subscription.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Everything worth acting on in your Microsoft tenant
Bsure finds everything from forgotten accounts and unused licenses to AI agents on the loose, then shows you what to fix first.
Why does this happen?
Bsure closes the gap, and keeps it closed
1.0 Identities
Users, guests, service principals, apps and AI agents, in one list, with who owns each one.
2.0 Risk signals
Admin rights nobody reviewed, no MFA, no owner, sign-ins from the wrong country. Ranked, with the reason next to each one.
3.0 Licenses
Seats on accounts nobody signs into, premium add-ons nobody opened. What each one costs, and what you would save.
4.0 My Team
Each manager gets a short list of their own accounts to confirm or clean up. The answer stays on record.

saved per month on licenses nobody used.

pages.title: Who Bsure is, and where we are based | Bsure
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Modern organizations run on identities. We help you run them responsibly.
Everyone means every part of the organization, not only the specialists who own it today. Each team sees what it owns, in plain words, and decides.
Employees arrive through HR. The cloud, devices, applications and now agents do not, and agents create their own accounts and access faster than anyone can follow by hand. That is what we build for.
Gartner put Identity Visibility and Intelligence Platforms on its Hype Cycle for Digital Identity: the visibility layer that sits above identity tools rather than beside them. Bsure covers Microsoft only, and goes deeper into it.
Bsure was founded in Norway in 2022, three years before the category had a name.
